Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring mandatory recounts for local ballot measures under certain conditions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mandatory recounts for local ballot measures;and amending RCW 29A.64.090.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 29A.64.090 and 2003 c 111 s 1609 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When the official canvass of returns of any election reveals thatthe difference in the number of votes cast for the approval of astatewide or local ballot measure and the number of votes cast for therejection of such measure is less than two thousand votes and also lessthan onehalf of one percent of the total number of votes cast on suchmeasure, ((the secretary of state shall direct that)) a recount of allvotes cast on such measure must be made ((on such measure,)) in themanner provided by RCW ((29A.64.040)) 29A.64.041 and ((29A.64.060,and)) 29A.64.061. The cost of ((such)) a recount of a statewidemeasure will be at the expense of the state ((expense)).
